Context: ExcEPTIONS:-

Termination of service.The services of a temporary Government servant may be terminated at any time by a notice of one month on either side by the Government servant or the Appointing Authority. The Appointing Authority has also the option to pay the Government servant his pay and allowance for the period of one month or for the period by which such notice falls short of one month and terminate his services immediately.
